description: A comprehensive data science application for stock analysis, feature engineering, ML modeling, and explainable AI (XAI) visualization.

user_stories.title: Asset Universe Selection & Ticker Input
user_stories.i_want_to: Provide a list of stock or crypto tickers manually or automatically select the top 10 S&P 500 tickers
user_stories.so_that: I can define my analysis universe and initialize the data pipeline.
features_covered: Top 10 S&P 500 selection by market cap
acceptance_criteria: System has function to fetch current top 10 S&P 500 tickers automatically
Invalid tickers are caught and reported to user
User can switch between manual and auto mode

implementation_advice.notes: Start here - foundational. Use yfinance for validation. Consider caching S&P 500 list.

user_stories.title: Multi-Resolution Market Data Fetching
user_stories.i_want_to: Fetch historical OHLCV data for multiple fixed intervals and horizons
user_stories.so_that: I can analyze different market regimes and have complete multi-timeframe data.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 timeframes fetched successfully for each ticker
Every row contains exact Date/Time timestamp
Volume data is present and non-null

implementation_advice.notes: Use yfinance's download function with interval parameter. Handle timezone conversions. Implement retry logic for API failures.

user_stories.title: Raw Data Storage
user_stories.i_want_to: Have all fetched datasets saved as CSV files in a structured directory
user_stories.so_that: I can reuse them outside the application and ensure data persistence.
features_covered: One CSV per ticker per interval
acceptance_criteria: Data saved to 'data/' folder with clear naming convention
CSV schema: Date, Open, High, Low, Close, Volume
Metadata file tracks what was fetched and when

implementation_advice.notes: Create data/raw/, data/processed/ folders. Use ticker_interval_date.csv naming. Add metadata.json for tracking.

user_stories.title: Rolling Window Generation
user_stories.i_want_to: Generate rolling windows across multiple horizons
user_stories.so_that: Temporal market behavior is captured consistently for all features.
acceptance_criteria: All window sizes defined as constants
Windows applied consistently across all features
Edge cases handled (insufficient data for window)
Windows aligned to trading days not calendar days

implementation_advice.notes: Create a config file for window sizes. Use pandas rolling() with min_periods. This is foundational for all subsequent features.

user_stories.title: Core Price Feature Creation
user_stories.i_want_to: Calculate base returns and rolling statistics for multiple window sizes
user_stories.so_that: The foundation for ML modeling is complete with baseline trends.
features_covered: Return Volatility (Std Dev) for all windows
acceptance_criteria: Volatility uses proper degrees of freedom
Features generated for all rolling windows

implementation_advice.notes: Use np.log for log returns. Rolling std with ddof=1. Careful with first N rows being NaN.

user_stories.title: High/Low Extreme Detection & Regime Analysis
user_stories.i_want_to: Identify rolling high and low extremes with dates
user_stories.so_that: Breakout and regime behavior can be modeled with support/resistance levels.
features_covered: Highest high per window with date
Lowest low per window with date
acceptance_criteria: Accurate high/low identification for each window

implementation_advice.notes: Use rolling().apply() with custom functions to track dates. idxmax/idxmin for date extraction.

user_stories.title: Trend and Momentum Indicators
user_stories.i_want_to: Calculate advanced technical indicators to capture market sentiment
user_stories.so_that: Directional strength and trend persistence can be learned by the model.

implementation_advice.notes: Use pandas ewm() for EMA. Consider ta-lib for optimized implementations. Vectorize calculations for speed.

user_stories.title: Volatility and Risk Metrics
user_stories.i_want_to: Compute volatility and downside risk features
user_stories.so_that: Market risk regimes can be identified and quantified.

implementation_advice.notes: ATR needs previous close. Drawdown: (current - running_max) / running_max. Cache running max for efficiency.

user_stories.title: Volume-Based Indicators
user_stories.i_want_to: Analyze volume trends relative to price
user_stories.so_that: Liquidity and participation effects are captured to confirm price movements.
acceptance_criteria: Volume metrics calculated for all windows
OBV accumulates correctly (±volume based on close)
Trend confirmation uses price direction + volume

implementation_advice.notes: OBV: cumsum of volume where close>prev_close, else -volume. VWAP resets daily if using intraday.

user_stories.title: Time and Structural Features
user_stories.i_want_to: Add seasonality context and time-based patterns
user_stories.so_that: Seasonality and structural patterns are learned by the model.
features_covered: Gap up/down flag (open vs prev close)
acceptance_criteria: All time features extracted from datetime index
Gap flags compare open to previous close
Features are integer encoded for ML

implementation_advice.notes: Use .dt accessor for time features. Consider sin/cos encoding for cyclical features. Gap = (Open - Prev_Close) / Prev_Close.

user_stories.title: Relative and Cross-Asset Features
user_stories.i_want_to: Add benchmark comparisons and cross-asset context
user_stories.so_that: Macro and relative performance context is included in the model.
acceptance_criteria: Beta calculated via rolling OLS regression
Risk-free rate fetched or assumed (e.g., 3-month T-bill)

implementation_advice.notes: Use rolling window OLS for beta. Fetch ^IRX for T-bill rate. Handle missing benchmark data gracefully.

user_stories.title: Leakage-Safe Label Generation
user_stories.i_want_to: Create forward-looking target variables without data leakage
user_stories.so_that: Supervised learning is reliable and predictions are realistic.
features_covered: Binary: Hit high in next N days
Binary: Hit low in next N days
acceptance_criteria: No data from time T used to predict time T
NaN values at the end of series handled
Labels align with features by index

implementation_advice.notes: CRITICAL: Use shift(-n) for forward values. Never use future data in features. Drop last N rows without labels during training.

user_stories.title: Model Training and Time-Series Validation
user_stories.i_want_to: Train ML models on engineered features using time-aware splits
user_stories.so_that: Predictions are realistic and avoid lookahead bias.
acceptance_criteria: Train/test split preserves time order (no shuffle)

implementation_advice.notes: Start with XGBoost/LightGBM (easier). Use TimeSeriesSplit with 5 folds. Track overfitting. Consider early stopping.

user_stories.title: Model Explainability with SHAP
user_stories.i_want_to: See SHAP values to understand why the model makes specific predictions
user_stories.so_that: Model decisions are transparent, auditable, and trustworthy.
acceptance_criteria: SHAP values calculated for test set
Beeswarm plot shows global feature impact
Force plot explains the latest prediction
Waterfall plot available for any single prediction

implementation_advice.notes: Use shap.TreeExplainer for XGBoost. Calculate on sample for speed. Cache SHAP values. Integrate with visualization layer.

user_stories.title: Minimal Analytical Dashboard
user_stories.i_want_to: View a simple UI that displays data, features, predictions, and explanations
user_stories.so_that: I can visually inspect the entire pipeline and model outputs.
acceptance_criteria: UI built with Streamlit or Dash

implementation_advice.notes: Streamlit recommended for simplicity. Use plotly for interactivity. Cache data/model loading. Create modular plotting functions.

phase_2_feature_engineering.goal: Complete feature set ready for modeling

technical_recommendations.architecture: Modular pipeline with clear separation: data ingestion -> feature engineering -> modeling -> visualization
technical_recommendations.testing: Unit tests for each feature calculation. Integration tests for end-to-end pipeline.
technical_recommendations.versioning: Track data versions, feature versions, and model versions separately
technical_recommendations.performance: Vectorize pandas operations. Use multiprocessing for multiple tickers. Cache intermediate results.
technical_recommendations.scalability: Consider Dask for larger datasets. Implement incremental feature updates.
technical_recommendations.monitoring: Log all data fetches, feature calculations, and model predictions. Track drift.

key_pitfalls_to_avoid: Data leakage: Never use future data in features. Always shift labels backward, features forward.
Lookahead bias: Ensure all rolling calculations only use past data.
Overfitting: Use proper time-series CV. Regularize models. Track train/val/test metrics separately.
Missing data: Handle NaN values consistently. Document imputation strategies.
Feature scaling: Normalize/standardize features before LSTM/Transformer training.
Target imbalance: Check class distribution for classification tasks. Use stratified sampling if needed.
